description:
£140 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to bring to the student lettings market this spacious six-bedroom maisonette, ideally situated on Jesmond Road in the popular area of Jesmond.

Arranged over two floors, the property offers generous accommodation throughout, comprising six well-proportioned bedrooms, a large kitchen, a spacious living room and two bathrooms. There is also a rear seating area, providing additional outdoor space for tenants to enjoy.

Ideally located for student living, the property offers convenient access to both Newcastle University and Northumbria University, as well as a fantastic range of local amenities. With its spacious layout and sought-after location, this property is an excellent option for students looking for great-value accommodation in Jesmond.

A fantastic opportunity for students looking for a spacious home in a prime location!

To arrange a viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team.
